items.prompt: Provide a personal statement in which you explain, in concrete terms, how the experience of studying in our program would contribute to your professional goals and personal development.
items.ru: Личное эссе о том, как учёба в программе поможет целям и развитию; нужно выбрать одно из трёх направлений. Около 700 слов, отправить по email.
items.evidence: 5) Personal statement ★Please submit the personal statement to hus.iudp@office.osaka-u.ac.jp by email Provide a personal statement in which you explain, in concrete terms, how the experience of studying in our program would contribute to your professional goals and personal development. In your statement, we are particularly interested in understanding how your academic background, interests, and future plans align with the structure and aims of our program. Be sure to include which of the three focus areas (Diversity and Inclusion Studies, Japan Studies, or Political and Global Studies) you are most interested in and why, and how you believe your presence would contribute to the academic community at The University of Osaka. This statement will help us assess your motivation, preparedness, and overall fit for the program. (approx. 700 words)

items.ru: Две рекомендации от учителей, карьерных консультантов или директора школы; каждое письмо с cover sheet в запечатанном конверте, подпись через клапан.
items.evidence: We require that you submit a recommendation letter from two recommenders (teachers, career counsellors, or the headteacher.). Select recommenders who possess sufficient knowledge to engage in a meaningful discussion regarding your academic and social capabilities, including an evaluation of your character. Each recommender should complete a recommendation letter and a Recommendation Cover Sheet. The Recommendation Cover Sheet is available on our website ( https://iudp.hus.osakau.ac.jp/admissions/). To facilitate the process, write down your name, date of birth, and graduation date on it and provide it to your recommenders. Please ask each recommender to place their Recommendation Cover Sheet with their letter of recommendation in an envelope, seal it, sign it across the seal and return it to you. Please do not open the sealed envelopes, as doing so will make your documents invalid.

items.ru: Некоторых поступающих могут пригласить на собеседование — лично или онлайн, если нужны уточнения. Сообщают по email.
items.evidence: Some applicants may be invited for an interview if we want more information or clarification. In such a case, we will contact you by email by February 17. The interview can be face-to-face or via an internet interface.

note: Языковой сертификат, транскрипты и паспорт — документы, не материалы заявки. Набор — на октябрь 2027.
